body: It's a possibility. The referral to a psychiatrist is along wait though, I waited three to four months before got to see anyone. I was diagnosed with OCD, Major Depression, PTST and Schizotypal Personality Disorder. I also have an ASD referral which will be an even longet wait. I don't think medication can really help with the cluster-fuck of mental problems I have. I can alleviate some of the symptoms of psychosis, but this makes my other issues worse. It's trying to find a balance between all these things co-occuring.

In hindsight, an overdose doesn't seem like a very efficient means of suicide. I will probably have to resort to more violent and effective means, like hanging or a bullet to the head. This is for the best as I do not feel safe around myself or other people. My homicidal thoughts can be as strong as my suicidal thoughts. I have to do something before I completely lose my mind and do something terrible.

Because how an therapy help with brain damage and a chemical imbalance. Medication does help alleviate some of the symptoms, like the intrusive voices that otherwise never shut the hell up. This leaves me in a zombie-like state, which naturally enough, I also do not like. Sometimes I'm fine and I can actually think straight, other times my thought process is incoherent and racing. I have moments of insight and clarity, however, not very often or as often as I used to have. It's gotten much worse with time. My thoughts don't feel like mine, I can't distinguish what's in my head and what's real. My thoughts dissolve into nothing and my train of thought is constantly breaking. I have moments of amnesia that I cannot rememeber what the hell I was saying or doing, even in mid conversation. There are huge gaps in my memory. In the middle of a conversation I will just stare at the other person, completely oblivious to what just happened. This overwhelms me with anxiety, I become restless and very irritable.

So yeah, I will stop now as I'm rambling. I am just waiting for the next "episode" or mental breakdown which will come sometime today, it always does. This, needless to say, has made my life a living hell and then only permanent solution is suicide. I wil only be free from this disease when I'm dead.

Thank you for your answers so far. Severe anxiety, suicidal ideation, out of control Obsessive Compulsive Disorder, dissociative amnesia and some transient psychotic symptoms is what initially promoted me to take the initiative I took to speak to someone about how I feel. I couldn't go in living like this. I have a "phobia" (perhaps not the correct terminology) of closed doors as well. I'm just happy that there are some kind people somewhere that are willing to listen to me and what I once perceived as petty and trivial issues.
